title: Session id
summary: Shows the session id when a session starts, so you can name it in handoffs and messages.
details: At each session start, resume or clear you see a line like Session ID: ... in the session, so you can name that session in handoffs and messages. It is for you when you pass session ids to other sessions or people. It copies a small hook script and adds a SessionStart entry to your settings; that script runs node once at start, prints the id, and uses no network.
risk: Runs once at session start and prints the id. No network.
